newsitem.title: USA: Funeral for six-year-old strangled in Colorado home.
newsitem.headline: Funeral for six-year-old strangled in Colorado home.

text.p: Funeral services were held on Tuesday for a six-year-old beauty pageant winner who was found strangled to death in her family's Colorado home hours after her mother told police the girl had been kidnapped.

No arrests have been made in the death of JonBenet Ramsey, whose body was found hidden in the basement of her wealthy family's 15-room Tudor-style brick home in Boulder on December 26. The girl's mother, Patricia, told police she had found a ransom note in the house early that morning.

"The heart refuses to accept the death of one so young, who is suddenly taken from us by cruelty and malice by some unworthy persons or persons," the Rev. W. Frank Harrington told about 150 mourners during a Presbyterian church service.
The girl, a former Little Miss Colorado, was born in Atlanta before the family moved to Boulder in 1991. She was buried on Tuesday at the St. James Episcopal Cemetary in Marietta, Georgia.

No arrests have been made and no suspects in the case have been publicly identified. Police have officially said little about the unusual murder, the city's only homicide this year. Law enforcement officials have declined to say specifically whether family members are suspects, saying only that no one had been ruled out.
A preliminary autopsy report said the girl had been strangled.
